task: Software compatibility of the published base/p50c text parameters with CPU F32 incremental cache execution
original_text: A quiet morning brings clear light.
parameter_conversion: Exact lifting of source BF16/F32 learned parameter values to F32; no optimization or requantization, no changed export files
source_to_target_mapping: model.language_model.<suffix> -> model.<suffix>; lm_head.weight is the tied model.embed_tokens.weight alias
eos_policy: No early EOS stop in this fixed software probe; only eight tokens are appended, and no completed answer or benchmark score is reported

comparator.scope: Every vocabulary logit at each compared last-token position

continuation_after_numeric_failure: Keep the predeclared eight incremental calls and record all mismatches if tensors/cache remain valid; otherwise record blocked status. Never change thresholds or select a replacement input.

budgets.rss_scope: Owned worker plus observed descendants; VmHWM and rusage also checked. Polling is not an instantaneous kernel RSS limit.

runtime_changes: Only child-process environment and own affinity/resource settings; no package installation, source/export edits, global environment changes, service changes or production activation
acceptance: Both variants complete every required finite/allclose/greedy/cache-length/parameter-immutability check within the fixed combined budget and verified source identity
claims_excluded: original BF16 or vLLM benchmark reproduction
speedup over the original author runtime
